config.text2frame.strategy.description: How text is applied to the game. The default is fine for most users.
config.text2frame.strategy.enumDescripti: safe (keeps edits made in the game)
config.text2frame.messageCheck.descripti: Warn about message lines wider than the window.
config.text2frame.messageCheck.enumDescr: auto (off when a word-wrap plugin is enabled)
config.text2frame.history.keep.descripti: How many apply/pull operations to keep in the history (.t2f-history in the game folder). 0 turns it off.
config.text2frame.tryEvent.clearPlayerTr: Make the player visible before running a page from the editor. When off, the player stays as the game has it (standing in front of an event always makes it visible).
config.text2frame.messageLineLength.desc: Characters (full width) per line of a message without a face. 0 works it out from System.json.
config.text2frame.reviewBeforeApply.desc: Show what will change in a diff and write only after you accept, when applying or pulling from a button. Apply-on-save writes without asking.
config.text2frame.englishTag.description: Write tags in English (<Face: >) when pulling from the game. When off, they are written with the Japanese tag names.
config.text2frame.omitDefaultTags.descri: When pulling from the game, omit face/background/position tags that match the defaults (the whole tag line disappears when all three do). Apply fills the defaults back in, so the game is unchanged.
config.text2frame.testPlayPage.descripti: The page to open for test play, relative to the game folder. Empty means index.html.
config.text2frame.openRunningText.descri: While test playing, open the text of the running event automatically (keeping the input on the game). Also switchable from the Switches & Variables panel.
config.text2frame.showDatabaseNames.desc: Show RPG Maker database names next to switch / variable / map ids (display only; nothing is written to the file).
config.text2frame.usageContextLines.desc: How many lines to show before and after each usage when a switch or variable is clicked in the database list.
config.text2frame.textBaseDir.descriptio: Base directory (relative to workspace) for text files. Apply / Pull operate on this directory.
config.text2frame.dataDir.description: RPG Maker data directory (relative to workspace) holding Map###.json / CommonEvents.json.
config.text2frame.modulePath.description: Explicit path to Text2Frame.js. Empty = auto-resolve.
